title: Degree-zero proper closed exchange for finite constant model constructible condensed modules
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$ and a commutative condensed ring $\Lambda$ isomorphic, as a ring object, to the all-continuous-map condensed ring of a finite discrete commutative ring annihilated by a power of $\ell$, $\mathbf Z_\ell$, $\mathbf Q_\ell$, a finite intermediate extension $E\subset\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, or its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Use the ordinary uncompleted internal-module derived categories and exact coefficient pullbacks [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull] in the small-site universe [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated, $f:X\to Y$ proper [def-weil-proper-morphism], and $c:C\hookrightarrow Y$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion] whose complementary open immersion is quasi-compact [def-weil-open-immersion]. Put $X_C=X\times_Y C$, with projections $a:X_C\to X$ and $f_C:X_C\to C$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. For every module sheaf $M$ with a finite constructible stratification and finite constant scalar models on its strata [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the component at $M[0]$ of the actual ordinary ambient exchange [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] is an isomorphism:
$$c^*Rf_*M[0]\longrightarrow R(f_C)_*a^*M[0].$$
No finite Tor amplitude, characteristic, finite presentation of $f$, or completeness hypothesis is imposed. The closed immersion and source may be empty.

source.place: (2), closed-complement calculation: degree-zero closed lifted-test argument of lem-sfb-qcqs-proper-constructible-closed-base-change, the degree-zero closed-test calculation. Agent-formulated sheaf case; the blueprint invokes proper base change rather than stating this generalization separately.

proof.text: Apply condensed_closed_exchange_affine_descent. In each cartesian affine quotient chart, proper base change gives IsProper fU; properness over an affine gives a qcqs source. The original source is qcqs since Y is qcqs. Finite constant stratified pullback proves constructibility of a^*M.

For K=(a^*M)[0], apply the source-independent closed_lifted_tests_detect_isomorphisms theorem. For each test V with V and its specified lift w-contractible, proper_constructible_lifted_test_restriction supplies invertibility of sectionsOver.map of exchange.app K. Conservative derived test sections therefore imply that the affine exact-pullback exchange at K is invertible.

The affine exact-pullback exchange just proved supplies the local hypothesis of condensed_closed_exchange_affine_descent. That theorem transports exact versus left-derived pullback and normalized open localization, and detects the original ambient mate on the inverse-image affine cover. Apply it to obtain the original unchanged conclusion.

theorem proper_constructible_closed_exchange_heart
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (hΛ :
      (∃ (A : Type) (_ : CommRing A) (_ : TopologicalSpace A)
          (_ : DiscreteTopology A) (_ : IsTopologicalRing A),
        Finite A ∧ (∃ n : ℕ, ∀ a : A, (ℓ ^ n) • a = 0) ∧
          Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj A))) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℤ_[ℓ])) ∨
      Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj ℚ_[ℓ])) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E))) ∨
      (∃ E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ,
        Nonempty (Mon.mk Λ ≅ Mon.mk (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E))))
    {X Y C : Scheme.{u}} [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f] (c : C ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion c]
    [QuasiCompact (Scheme.Opens.ι (X := Y)
      ⟨(Set.range c)ᶜ, c.isClosedEmbedding.isClosed_range.isOpen_compl⟩)]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hM : IsConstantModelConstructible Λ X M) :
    IsIso ((condensedAmbientExchange Λ
      (g' := pullback.fst f c) (f' := pullback.snd f c) (f := f) (g := c)
      { w := pullback.condition
        isoPullback := Iso.refl _
        hom_fst := Category.id_comp _
        hom_snd := Category.id_comp _ }).app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))
